summary: Monroe Capital Income Plus Corp, a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 964,518 common shares at $9.75 per share for gross proceeds of approximately $9.4 million, issued under subscription agreements and exempt via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D or S; the share count was finalized September 21, 2026, following a September 1 issuance. The board also declared a $0.068 per-share dividend, payable September 28 to holders of record September 22, and disclosed an August 31 NAV per share of $9.75. This is a routine NAV-priced capital raise plus distribution, not a special situation.
